meta.title: Data & AI engineering jobs, Monterrey & Austin
meta.description: Snowflake data engineering, analytics, and AI roles at Viewnear. Work from our Monterrey, Nuevo León delivery center or Austin, Texas, on enterprise data across the Americas.

hero.title: Build the data and AI work <hl>enterprises keep</hl>
hero.description: We hire data engineers, analytics engineers, architects, and AI engineers into real production work on Snowflake, from our delivery center in Monterrey and our Austin office.

whoHeading.title: Engineers who want the hard version
whoHeading.intro: The work here is enterprise data: real ERP estates, real governance constraints, real production consequences. That shapes who does well.

who.label: Depth
who.title: One platform, properly
who.body: We specialize in Snowflake rather than sampling five tools. People who like knowing a platform to its edges, and getting certified to prove it, tend to thrive.

who.label: Ownership
who.title: You scope what you build
who.body: The people who size an engagement are the people who deliver it. That means talking to clients, defending a design, and standing behind the result.

who.label: Craft
who.title: Judged on outcomes
who.body: Not on hours logged. We price work on results, which only holds up if the engineering is genuinely good and the handover genuinely lands.

who.label: Language
who.title: Bilingual by default
who.body: Client sessions run in English and the team works in English and Spanish. Both matter here, and neither has to be perfect on day one.

locations.title: Monterrey and Austin, on <hl>US business hours</hl>
locations.body: Most engineering sits in our Monterrey delivery center, in Valle Alto, with leadership in Austin, Texas. The team works US business hours, which means a normal working day here overlaps with clients across the Americas instead of running on a night shift. Onsite client travel happens, and Monterrey makes it short.
bullets: Carr. Nacional 500, Valle Alto, Monterrey, NL 64989, Mexico
Central Time all year, aligned to the client's working day
Nonstop flights to major US cities for onsite work when a build needs it

growthHeading.title: Certification, then real delivery
growthHeading.intro: Nobody learns Snowflake from a course alone. The path pairs certification with production work from the first sprint.

growth: SnowPro certification, paid for and part of the growth path
Pairing with architects on live client builds, not sandbox exercises
Work on the full Snowflake stack as a Premier and CoCo Preferred Partner
AI-native tooling as part of the job, including Claude as an Anthropic partner

life.title: What comes with it
life.body: Benefits, how the team actually works, and the offices themselves are laid out on the culture page.

cta.title: Send it, even if the fit is not obvious.
cta.subtitle: Tell us what you have built and where you want to go next. Every application is read by a person on the team.
